sentences.en: Milly had an excessive amount of alcohol in her blood.
sentences.zh: 米尔莉血液中的酒精含量过多。

sentences.en: Excessive drinking is one of the causes of impotence.
sentences.zh: 过度饮酒是导致性功能障碍的原因之一。

sentences.en: Excessive gambling causes the same brain changes as a drug addiction.
sentences.zh: 过度赌博会导致与药物成瘾相似的大脑变化。

senses.zh: 过度的，极度的,过分的,过多的,过逾
